title: When the Gravity Wakes
author: Bram Voss
blurb: Rosalind Eriksen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
